normal.name: argv[-1]
normal.text: The final map of #Doom 2 In Rural Only has 2897 sectors, 8039 things, 4223~5099 monsters, and 32014 vertices, most of which are visible at the same time because it's one not-really-subdivided big open outdoor space! You know what the most demanding map in vanilla Doom 2 is? MAP29: 205 sectors, 276 things, 1180 vertices, and 106 monsters. That's hundred, not thousand. And even those aren't all visible at the same blasted time. My #CPU is begging for mercy here. #gaming #retrogaming

normal.name: argv[-1]
normal.text: Dear #Doom mappers, This is Doom. It does not have level-of-detail. It does not have distance culling. If you make a huge map with a million sectors all joined together, the engine draws ALL of them at the same time. I should not get 10 frames/second playing f***ing Doom on a f***ing Ryzen. I know we don't have a visplane limit any more but JFC. What PC are you all testing these maps on?? Please, for the love of Oremor, divide up your maps with walls or something jeez. #gaming #retrogaming

normal.name: zeratul2099
normal.text: Watched the Street Fighter movie from 1994 yesterday. Not as bad as I suspected. Don't get me wrong, it is no good movie, it is involuntarily comical and it has, except for the characters, nothing to do with the games. But Raul Julia as M Bison carries the whole movie. A great piece of acting of the movies villain. It is pure fun to watch his monologues. Sadly, Raul Julia passed away after the filming and just before the release of the movie. #retrogaming #streetfighter #gamingmovies #sf2

normal.text: Visited some local fest for retrogamers and board-gamers and found a decently good laptop from 199x - some Compaq with DOS and good thickness. I still not forget how to use 3.5" diskettes! 😎 It has an integrated keyboard which could be detached from the main case and used like a separate keyboard, connected to the laptop 🙂. Nice feature - Num/Caps/Scroll Lock buttons have a LEDs to indicate it's state. And analog, physical control to setup brightness and contrast for display ^_^ #compaq #dos #PrinceOfPersia #retrogaming #retrocomputing

normal.text: Our GM made the mistake of giving out Factspiration points for telling jokes. If you win the die roll, you tell a joke and get a point. (They're useful in game.) Then, you get to choose another willing PC or any NPC you want to tell a joke, too. We've just killed 10 minutes making the GM tell jokes as various NPCs (including one from like 20 sessions back). #GameNight #Dragonbane
